newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal state carrier TAP pilots set strike date.
newsitem.headline: Portugal state carrier TAP pilots set strike date.

text.p: Pilots at loss-making state airline TAP-Air Portugal gave warning on Tuesday of a two-day strike on April 24 and 25 to press for fewer working hours.
The Union of Civil Aviation Pilots (SPAC), which represents all the company's 430 pilots, said that the strike would affect all company flights except some incoming ones.
The union, which staged an overtime ban in March, is obliged by law to give prior warning of any intended stoppage.
Pilots say that they are forced to work excessive hours which put the safety of planes at risk.

The company counters that its pilots work less than in other European airlines and that a review of working practices is essential to the company's chances of finding a strategic partner to face the ever greater competition in the international airline industry.

Earlier, company chairman Manuel Ferreira Lima had warned that strike action could threaten TAP's chances of making a profit this year for the first time since 1974 and of its being privatisated in the next two years, as the government plans.
